 Durchführung manueller Softwaretests im Embedded-Bereich

•
 Testausführung in einem regulierten Umfeld, vorzugsweise in der Medizintechnik

•
 Review von Anforderungen hinsichtlich Testbarkeit und Vollständigkeit

•
 Erstellung und Pflege von Testprozeduren, Testberichten und Testdokumentation

Dein Profil:

•
 Erfahrung in der Software-Testautomatisierung , idealerweise mit C#

•
 Erfahrung in der manuellen Softwaretestung von Embedded-Systemen

•
 Kenntnisse in regulierten Entwicklungsumgebungen (Medizintechnik von Vorteil)

Descrizione

Siamo alla ricerca di un ingegnere di test software con esperienza nel test di software automatizzato e manuale. L'obiettivo di questa posizione è quello di testare il software incorporato in un ambiente regolamentato, idealmente in tecnologia medica. Lavorano a stretto contatto con i team di sviluppo in un ambiente agile e contribuiscono in modo significativo a garantire la qualità del software.

Informazioni sul lavoro

- Sviluppo e manutenzione di test software automatizzati con C#
- Creazione di test software basati su requisiti e procedure di test definite
- Analisi dei requisiti e derivazione dei casi di test automatizzati idonei
- Condurre test di software manuali in aree integrate
- Esecuzione di test in un ambiente regolamentato, preferibilmente in tecnologia medica
- Valutazione dei requisiti in materia di testabilità e completezza
- Creazione e manutenzione di procedure di prova, rapporti di prova e documentazione di prova

Requisiti

- Esperienza nell'automazione dei test software, idealmente con C#
- Esperienza nel test manuale del software dei sistemi incorporati
- Conoscenza degli ambienti di sviluppo regolamentati (tecnologia medica di vantaggio)
- Esperienza nella revisione dei requisiti e nella creazione di test e documentazione
- Esperienza con metodi di sviluppo agili

Cosa?

- La capacità di utilizzare le tue abilità in un ambiente agile
- Un team di esperti sviluppatori e tester
- La possibilità di utilizzare le tue competenze in un ambiente regolamentato
- La capacità di far progredire la tua carriera nello sviluppo del software

Descrizione

We are looking for a software test engineer with experience in automated and manual software testing. The focus of this position is on testing embedded software in a regulated environment, ideally in medical technology. They work closely with development teams in an agile environment and contribute significantly to ensuring software quality.

Aspetti del lavoro

- Development and maintenance of automated software tests with C#
- Creation of software tests based on requirements and defined test procedures
- Analysis of requirements and derivation of suitable automated test cases
- Conducting manual software tests in embedded areas
- Test execution in a regulated environment, preferably in medical technology
- Review of requirements regarding testability and completeness
- Creation and maintenance of test procedures, test reports and test documentation

Requisiti

- Experience in software test automation, ideally with C#
- Experience in manual software testing of embedded systems
- Knowledge of regulated development environments (medical technology of advantage)
- Experience in the requirements review as well as in test creation and documentation
- Experience with agile development methods

Cosa offriamo

- The ability to use your skills in an agile environment
- A team of experienced developers and testers
- The chance to use your expertise in a regulated environment
- The ability to advance your career in software development

Contatto

jobs.description:
positionnement stratégique du portefeuille industriel et immobilier de l’EuroAirport.

Votre mission consiste à développer de nouvelles opportunités de croissance, à acquérir de nouveaux partenaires industriels et à contribuer activement à l’évolution des activités industrielles et commerciales de l’Aéroport.

Vous évoluez au sein d’un environnement d’infrastructure complexe et international, à l’interface entre industrie, immobilier, logistique et aviation.

Cette fonction joue un rôle clé dans le développement de l’écosystème industriel de l’EuroAirport, notamment dans les secteurs liés à l’aviation tels que le MRO (Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul), les FBO (Fixed Base Operators) ainsi que d’autres partenaires industriels stratégiques.

Vous êtes directement rattaché au Chief Commercial Officer et collaborez étroitement avec les parties prenantes internes et externes de l’écosystème trinational.

Vos missions principales

Développement commercial & industriel

• Identifier, prospecter et acquérir de nouveaux partenaires industriels et commerciaux

• Développer de nouvelles opportunités de croissance et de revenus au sein du portefeuille industriel de l’Aéroport

• Assurer le suivi stratégique et opérationnel des clients et partenaires existants

• Développer et entretenir des relations durables avec les partenaires industriels, institutionnels et économiques

• Identifier les besoins des clients et analyser les chaînes de valeur afin de détecter de nouvelles opportunités de développement

• Concevoir et piloter des initiatives de développement commercial et de fidélisation

Développement stratégique & Real Estate Development

• Concevoir et développer des concepts d’utilisation pour des surfaces industrielles et commerciales existantes ou futures

• Élaborer des business cases, analyser des scénarios de développement et évaluer les investissements nécessaires

• Participer activement au repositionnement stratégique du portefeuille industriel et immobilier

• Assurer une veille approfondie des marchés, des tendances sectorielles ainsi que des évolutions techniques et logistiques

• Produire et présenter des analyses et rapports réguliers à la direction

• Contribuer au pilotage financier ainsi qu’à la gestion budgétaire des projets

Relations institutionnelles & représentation externe

• Représenter l’EuroAirport lors de salons, événements professionnels et rencontres sectorielles

• Participer au développement et au rayonnement de l’écosystème industriel et économique de l’Aéroport

• Développer et entretenir des relations avec les partenaires institutionnels et économiques

• Contribuer activement au positionnement stratégique et à la visibilité de l’EuroAirport

Collaboration interne & projets transverses

• Participer à des projets transversaux impliquant plusieurs départements

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes internes (technique, commercial, marketing, finance, exploitation)

• Assurer la cohérence et la coordination des initiatives de développement

• Préparer des supports décisionnels, analyses et business cases pour le management

Votre profil

Pour cette fonction stratégique et évolutive, nous recherchons une personnalité entrepreneuriale capable d’identifier des opportunités de croissance, de développer des partenariats stratégiques et de contribuer activement au développement commercial et industriel de l’EuroAirport.

Vous disposez idéalement des qualifications et expériences suivantes :

• Diplôme universitaire (Master) en gestion d’entreprise, ingénierie, immobilier, finance, stratégie ou domaine équivalent

• Plusieurs années d’expérience dans des fonctions telles que le business development, le développement industriel, le développement immobilier, le conseil en stratégie ou des environnements liés à l’investissement

• Expérience avérée dans les négociations commerciales, les structures contractuelles et les modèles de partenariat

• Bonne compréhension des chaînes de valeur industrielles, infrastructurelles ou idéalement liées à l’aviation

• Expérience dans l’élaboration de business cases, d’analyses financières et de scénarios d’investissement

• Capacité à structurer des problématiques complexes et à formuler des recommandations concrètes

• Excellentes compétences en gestion de projets et coordination de parties prenantes

• Très bonnes capacités de communication et de négociation

• Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais (niveau B2/C1 minimum) ; de bonnes connaissances de l’allemand constituent un réel atout

Votre personnalité

Vous évoluez avec aisance dans des environnements complexes, internationaux et multi-acteurs et savez concilier des intérêts variés.

Vous vous distinguez également par :

• Un fort esprit entrepreneurial et une orientation résultats

• Une grande autonomie et un sens élevé des responsabilités

• Une approche structurée, analytique et orientée solutions

• Une excellente aisance relationnelle et capacité à instaurer la confiance

• Une forte capacité de conviction et de négociation

• Un esprit d’équipe et une capacité à collaborer de manière transversale

Notre offre

Nous vous proposons une fonction stratégique au sein d’un environnement international et multidisciplinaire.

Cette position vous offre :

• Un rôle clé avec une exposition directe à la direction

• Un environnement unique à l’interface entre infrastructure, industrie, immobilier et aviation

• Une grande autonomie et des possibilités concrètes de contribuer au développement de nouveaux axes de croissance

• Une collaboration au sein d’un écosystème trinational

• Des conditions d’engagement attractives et des modèles de travail modernes

strategic positioning of EuroAirport's industrial and real estate portfolio.

Your mission is to develop new growth opportunities, acquire new industrial partners and actively contribute to the development of the airport's industrial and commercial activities.

You are evolving within a complex and international infrastructure environment, at the interface between industry, real estate, logistics and aviation.

This function plays a key role in the development of the EuroAirport's industrial ecosystem, particularly in aviation-related sectors such as the MRO (Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul), the FBO (Fixed Base Operators) and other strategic industrial partners.

You are directly attached to the Chief Commercial Officer and work closely with internal and external stakeholders in the trinational ecosystem.

Your main missions

Commercial & Industrial Development

• Identify, explore and acquire new industrial and commercial partners

• Develop new growth and revenue opportunities within the airport's industrial portfolio

• Ensure strategic and operational monitoring of existing clients and partners

• Develop and maintain sustainable relations with industrial, institutional and economic partners

• Identify customer needs and analyse value chains to detect new development opportunities

• Design and pilot business development and retention initiatives

Strategic Development & Real Estate Development

• Design and develop use concepts for existing or future industrial and commercial surfaces

• Develop business boxes, analyse development scenarios and assess the investments needed

• Actively participate in strategic repositioning of the industrial and real estate portfolio

• Ensure in-depth monitoring of markets, sectoral trends and technical and logistical developments

• Produce and submit regular analyses and reports to management

• Contribute to financial management and budget management of projects

Institutional Relations & External Representation

• Represent EuroAirport at trade shows, events and industry meetings

• Participate in the development and dissemination of the industrial and economic ecosystem of the Airport

• Develop and maintain relations with institutional and economic partners

• Actively contribute to the strategic positioning and visibility of EuroAirport

Internal collaboration & cross-cutting projects

• Participate in cross-cutting projects involving several departments

• Work closely with internal teams (technical, commercial, marketing, finance, operating)

• Ensure coherence and coordination of development initiatives

• Prepare decision-making materials, analysis and business boxes for management

• University degree (Master) in business management, engineering, real estate, finance, strategy or equivalent

• Several years of experience in functions such as business development, industrial development, real estate development, strategy consulting or investment-related environments

• A high degree of autonomy and responsibility

• A structured, analytical and solutions-oriented approach

• Excellent relational ease and confidence building capacity

• Strong capacity for conviction and negotiation

• Team spirit and ability to work together in a cross-cutting way

Our offer

We offer you a strategic function within an international and multidisciplinary environment.

This position offers you:

• A key role with direct exposure to management

• A unique environment at the interface between infrastructure, industry, real estate and aviation

• Greater autonomy and concrete opportunities to contribute to the development of new growth axes

• Collaboration within a trinational ecosystem

• Attractive engagement conditions and modern work models

• Beitrag zur Organisation von Klienten und institutionellen Veranstaltungen

• Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu institutionellen Akteuren und Industriepartnern

jobs.description:

• Klärung von Rückfragen mit internen Fachabteilungen („Linie“) sowie externen Lieferanten

• Mitarbeit bei internationalen Buchhaltungsprozessen, insbesondere im Umfeld von Intercompany-Transaktionen

• Unterstützung bei Monatsabschlüssen im Bereich Kreditoren

• Sicherstellung von Compliance- und Qualitätsstandards im Rechnungswesen

• Verarbeitung der Mitarbeiterspesen mit einer Spesensoftware

Dein Profil:

• Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung

• Kaufmännische Grundausbildung, idealerweise ergänzt durch ein Sachbearbeiter-Diplom
Rechnungswesen

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit digitalen Workflow-Systemen in der Rechnungsverarbeitung

• Erfahrung im internationalen Umfeld sowie im Umgang mit Intercompany-Transaktionen von Vorteil

• Gute Kenntnisse in MS Excel sowie idealerweise Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen ( Microsoft D365) sowie mit MediusFlow, Rydoo

• Exakte, strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise

• Selbstständigkeit sowie Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen und Fristen einzuhalten

• Fliessende Deutsch- sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

jobs.description:
Position verantwortest du die Konzeption, Beratung sowie Umsetzung innovativer Pega-basierter Lösungen und bildest die Schnittstelle zwischen Business-Anforderungen und technischen Lösungsarchitekturen.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Anwendung von Pega Blueprint zur strukturierten Aufnahme und Übersetzung von Business-Anforderungen in skalierbare Architektur- und Umsetzungskonzepte

• Eigenständige End-to-End-Umsetzung von Proof of Concepts (PoCs) inklusive Lösungsdesign, Validierung und Präsentation beim Kunden

• Fachliche Führung und Steuerung interdisziplinärer Projektteams zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung hochwertiger Pega-Lösungen

• Beratung von Kunden zu Pega-Funktionalitäten , Architekturprinzipien, Best Practices sowie Transformations- und Optimierungsansätzen

• Durchführung und Moderation von Workshops wie Blueprint Sessions , Journey Mapping , DCO-Workshops und Lösungsdesign-Workshops

• Konzeption und Design robuster IT-Lösungen und Geschäftsprozesse mittels BPMN-Modellierung , Prozessdesign und technischer Lösungsarchitektur

• Nutzung von Pega App Studio , um Workflows, Standardfunktionalitäten und Zielarchitekturen live zu demonstrieren

• Vorantreiben der Workflow-Transformation durch den strategischen Einsatz vorkonfigurierter Pega-Komponenten

• Sicherstellung eines professionellen Stakeholder-Managements sowie aktiver Austausch mit Business- und IT-Stakeholdern

• Anwendung agiler Methoden wie Scrum zur iterativen Umsetzung von Projekten und zur strukturierten Steuerung des Projektfortschritts

• Überführung komplexer Business-Anforderungen in nachhaltige und skalierbare Lösungsarchitekturen

Dein Profil:

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Pega Business Architect , System Architect , Solution Architect oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle

• Fundierte Erfahrung mit Pega oder vergleichbaren Low-Code-, BPM- oder CRM-Plattformen wie Appian oder Camunda

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Business Process Management (BPM) sowie in der BPMN-Modellierung

• Erfahrung im IT-Lösungsdesign , insbesondere in den Bereichen Case Lifecycle Design , Data Modeling , Integration Design und UI-Konzepte

• Praktische Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden, insbesondere Scrum

• Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Requirements Engineering und Anforderungsmanagement

• Erfahrung in der Durchführung und Moderation von Workshops sowie im Stakeholder-Management

• Starker Consulting Background mit nachweisbaren Erfolgen in CRM- oder BPM-Transformationsprojekten

• Hohe Kundenorientierung sowie überzeugende Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenz

• Idealerweise relevante Pega-Zertifizierungen wie LBA, BA, SSA oder LSA

• Ausgeprägtes Interesse und hohe Motivation, sich tief in Pega einzuarbeiten und sich fachlich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln

descriptionByLocale.en:
Position is responsible for the design, consulting and implementation of innovative pega-based solutions and the interface between business requirements and technical solution architectures.

Your tasks:

• Application of Pega Blueprint for the structured recording and translation of business requirements in scalable architecture and implementation concepts

• Independent end-to-end conversion of Proof of Concepts (PoCs) including solution design, validation and presentation at the customer

• Professional leadership and management of interdisciplinary project teams to successfully implement high-quality pega solutions

• Advice from customers on pega functionalities, architecture principles, best practices and transformation and optimization approaches

• Implementation and moderation of workshops such as Blueprint Sessions, Journey Mapping, DCO workshops and solution design workshops

• Design and design of robust IT solutions and business processes using BPMN modelling, process design and technical solution architecture

• Use of Pega App Studio to demonstrate live workflows, standard functionality and target architectures

• Promote workflow transformation by strategic use of preconfigured pega components

• Ensuring professional stakeholder management and active exchange with business and IT stakeholders

• Application of agile methods such as Scrum for iterative implementation of projects and for structured management of project progress

• Transfer of complex business requirements into sustainable and scalable solution architectures

Your profile:

• Multiannual experience as Pega Business Architect, System Architect, Solution Architect or in a comparable role

• Experience with Pega or comparable low-code, BPM or CRM platforms such as Appian or Camunda

• Very good knowledge of Business Process Management (BPM) and BPMN modelling

• Experience in IT solution design, in particular in Case Lifecycle Design, Data Modeling, Integration Design and UI concepts

• Practical experience with agile methods, especially Scrum

• Embossed skills in requirements engineering and requirement management

• Experience in the implementation and moderation of workshops and stakeholder management

• Strong consulting background with detectable successes in CRM or BPM transformation projects

• High customer orientation and convincing communication and consulting skills

• Ideally relevant pega certifications such as LBA, BA, SSA or LSA

• Impressed interest and high motivation to work deep into Pega and to develop professionally continuously

For our client, we are looking for an experienced Requirements Engineer who confidently defines and structures technical requirements for diagnostic instruments in a regulated environment, effectively collaborates within interdisciplinary development teams, and brings strong expertise in requirements engineering, ALM tools, and product development lifecycles, in order to ensure compliant, traceable, and high-quality software and hardware requirements throughout the development process.

For our client, we are looking for an experienced Program Delivery Manager / Scrum Master who confidently drives delivery roadmaps across multiple agile teams, coordinates cross-functional dependencies and releases, and brings strong expertise in agile methodologies, stakeholder management, and cross-team collaboration, in order to ensure transparent, efficient, and high-quality delivery of complex programs from MVP through multiple release cycles.

Start date: 01.07.2026
End date: 30.11.2027
Workload: 100% (up to 50% remote working possible)
Contract Type: Contracting
Location: Kaiseraugst

Your Tasks:

Program & Delivery Management

• Own and drive delivery planning across multiple agile teams from MVP through subsequent releases

• Manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers to ensure smooth delivery execution

• Lead release management activities, including release planning and coordination with Development, QA, and Operations

• Ensure structured scope and requirements management processes

• Provide transparent program status reporting to stakeholders and leadership

Scrum Master & Agile Coaching

• Facilitate Scrum ceremonies for multiple delivery teams (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives)

• Remove impediments and protect teams from external disruptions

• Coach teams on agile best practices and continuous improvement

Cross-Team Coordination

• Coordinate collaboration and alignment across multiple delivery teams

• Facilitate Scrum of Scrums and dependency management sessions

• Maintain Jira as the central source of truth and ensure consistent Jira governance across teams

• Enable effective collaboration between onsite and distributed international teams

• Coordinate with adjacent programs and platform teams on integration dependencies

Your Profile:

• 7+ years of project management experience in software delivery, including 3+ years managing programmes with multiple parallel teams

• Demonstrated Scrum Master experience - you have facilitated agile teams, not just observed them. You know how to run an effective retro and how to coach without directing

• Pharmaceutical or Life Sciences industry experience with understanding of GxP requirements and what inspection readiness means in practice

• Strong risk and dependency management skills with a bias toward action

• Experience managing distributed hybrid teams across multiple time zones

• Fluent English communication - written and verbal

jobs.title: IT Support Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
For our client in Basel, we are looking for an IT Support Engineer (m/f/d) to support daily IT operations and ensure reliable end-user services.

In this role, you will provide Level 2 support for hardware and software issues, manage user accounts in Active Directory and Azure AD (Entra ID), and assist users with Windows and Microsoft 365 environments. You will also troubleshoot network connectivity issues, handle incidents through an ITSM tool such as ServiceNow, and contribute to maintaining secure and efficient IT systems.

Start date: asap
End date: 6-months contract (with the chance for extension)
Workload: 60%
Contract Type: Contracting
Location: Basel

Your tasks:

• Provide Level 2 technical support for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, meeting rooms, printers, and peripherals

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Windows OS, Microsoft 365, including email, VPN, and collaboration tools (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)

• Manage user accounts and access in Active Directory (on-prem) and Azure AD (Entra ID), including onboarding and offboarding

• Install, configure, and maintain hardware and software according to company standards

• Monitor and respond to incidents and service requests using an ITSM tool (ServiceNow)

• Perform root cause analysis and escalate complex issues to Level 3 teams when required

• Support network connectivity issues (LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, VPN, firewall troubleshooting)

• Ensure compliance with IT security policies, data protection, and audit requirements

• Maintain documentation for procedures, configurations, and troubleshooting guides

• Assist in IT projects such as system upgrades, migrations, and rollout of new tools

• Provide user training and guidance on best practices and security awareness

Your Profile:

• 5–6 years of experience in IT Support / Desktop Support / End User Computing role

• Windows 10/11, basic Linux/macOS (optional)

• Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)

• Microsoft Active Directory and Azure AD (Entra ID)

• Basic networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN)

• Experience with endpoint management tools (Intune or similar)

• Familiarity with ITSM tools and ticketing processes (ITIL framework or similar )

• Strong troubleshooting skills

• Ability to work independently and handle multiple priorities
